source: input bounds (contract R1, R6, R18, R19, R31). An excess 0 case is well formed apart from its size and is accepted by the reader its op names; excess 1 is TooLarge. Every case carries its bytes: hex in `input` up to 4096 bytes, base64url in `input_b64url` above, with input_len and input_sha256 and a recipe saying how they were built

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R6 (clientDataJSON size)
cases.recipe: the members type, challenge, origin and crossOrigin of a webauthn.get clientDataJSON, then a string member `pad` of 'a' bytes, the whole document exactly bound+excess bytes

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R6 (nesting past MAX_CLIENT_DATA_DEPTH is TooLarge; the top-level object is depth 1)
cases.recipe: a valid webauthn.get clientDataJSON with a member `x` holding nested objects so that the deepest container is at depth bound+excess

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R40 (the attestation object's size)
cases.recipe: a fmt none attestation object whose attStmt map holds one `pad` entry of zero bytes, the whole object exactly bound+excess bytes (shape only; the none rules are not applied)

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R4 (authenticator data's size)
cases.recipe: authenticator data of UP|UV|ED whose extensions map holds one `pad` entry of zero bytes, the whole value exactly bound+excess bytes (shape only)

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R2 (CBOR nesting depth; the outer array is depth 1)
cases.recipe: nested one-element arrays 0x81 ... 0x81 0x00 whose depth is bound+excess

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R2 (CBOR item count, the array itself included)
cases.recipe: one definite array of bound+excess-1 items of 0x00, so the item count with the array itself is bound+excess

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R18 (TrustAnchor::from_der takes one DER certificate of at most MAX_CERTIFICATE bytes)
cases.recipe: a self-signed P-256 certificate whose non-critical private extension is padded so the DER is exactly bound+excess bytes

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R9 (an RP ID of at most MAX_RP_ID bytes in all)
cases.recipe: lowercase 'a' labels of at most 63 bytes joined by dots, bound+excess bytes in all

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R10 (an AppID of at most MAX_APP_ID bytes)
cases.recipe: https://example.org/ then 'a' bytes, bound+excess bytes in all

cases.spec: contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R31 (an exclude list over MAX_LISTED_CREDENTIALS)
contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R1 (an Allow::User list over MAX_LISTED_CREDENTIALS)
contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R31 (a PRF salt over MAX_PRF_SALT)

contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R61 (a PRF salt over MAX_PRF_SALT at start_authentication; the salt is base64url as in the other authentication extension requests)

contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R61 (a ceremony row that Record::encode refuses past MAX_RECORD; the row is the 91 fixed bytes of a discoverable ceremony with default options plus the largeBlob write, so the blob length sets the row length: bound+excess-91)
contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R19 (more than MAX_ORIGINS origins and top origins together)
contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) (a timeout over MAX_TIMEOUT_SECS seconds)
contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and N16 (a stored handle is 1 to MAX_USER_HANDLE bytes)
contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and N18 (name and display name are checked for length and emptiness only)
contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) (AuthenticationResponse::new reads a signature of at most MAX_SIGNATURE bytes; it is not verified at construction)
contract R1 (each bound is a public constant; input past it is TooLarge) and R127 (a blob past MAX_LARGE_BLOB is TooLarge)
cases.recipe: the byte 0x03 repeated bound+excess times, returned as the largeBlob `blob` after a Read request
